newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela exporting 100,000 bpd heating oil -- PDVSA.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela exporting 100,000 bpd heating oil -- PDVSA.

text.p: Venezuela is currently exporting about 100,000 barrels per day (bpd) of heating oil and is unlikely to increase that level despite high demand especially in the United States, state oil company Petroleos de Venezuela SA (PDVSA) President Luis Giusti said Friday.
"The exports of heating oil are at about 100,000 barrels per day," Giusti told Reuters after addressing a business conference in eastern Venezuela.
Traditional seasonal demand combined with low inventories have seen U.S. heating oil prices rocket in recent days, but "we are stisfying our market," Giusti said.

PDVSA officials also in Maturin explained that demand for all products was high and that if Venezuela were to increase exports of any product it would be gasoline which is easier and cheaper to produce.
U.S. Energy Secretary Hazel O'Leary said Tuesday that high U.S. heating oil prices might be curbed by luring additional imports from Venezuela.
Venezuelan Energy and Mines Minister Erwin Arrieta denied Thursday that the United States had approached Venezuela to increase its heating oil exports.
